questions.q: What was Black Beauty pulling on the long business journey?
choices: The dog-cart
The heavy carriage
A farm wagon
Captain Langley's cart
questions.evidence: I was put into the dog-cart

questions.q: What did the man at the toll-gate say in the morning?
choices: The river was rising fast
The bridge had been mended
The road was closed ahead
A storm would come by noon

questions.q: What happened as they drove past the wood on the way home?
choices: An oak tree crashed down across the road just before them
A wheel came off the dog-cart in a deep muddy rut
Black Beauty cast a shoe on the stony road
They met James riding Justice with a message
questions.evidence: came an oak, torn up by the roots, and it fell right across the road just before us

questions.q: How did Black Beauty act when the tree fell?
choices: He was frightened and stopped still, but did not run away
He bolted back toward the town as fast as he could go
He leaped clean over the fallen branches and kept going
He was not frightened at all and just trotted on calmly
questions.evidence: I stopped still, and I believe I trembled

questions.q: Why did they have to go back to the four crossways?
choices: They could not get over or around the fallen tree
The master had left his papers back in the town
John wanted to try a shorter road through the wood
Black Beauty was too tired to go on that way
questions.evidence: we can't drive over that tree, nor yet get round it

questions.q: What did Black Beauty do the moment his feet touched the bridge?
choices: He made a dead stop and would not go on
He galloped across as fast as he could
He turned and ran back up the road
He reared up and nearly upset the cart

questions.q: Why did Black Beauty refuse to cross the bridge even when the master used the whip?
choices: He knew the bridge was not safe
He was afraid of the dark water
He was too tired to go any farther
He wanted to go home another way
questions.evidence: I knew very well that the bridge was not safe

questions.q: What did the toll-gate man shout to warn them?
choices: The bridge was broken in the middle
The river was full of floating logs
The road ahead was flooded and closed
A tree had fallen across his gate
questions.evidence: The bridge is broken in the middle

questions.q: What did the master say God had given animals that saved them that night?
choices: Knowledge that does not depend on reason
Strong legs that can outrun any danger
Sharp eyes that see far in daylight
Loud voices to call out a warning
questions.evidence: he had given animals knowledge which did not depend on reason

questions.q: How had the mistress felt while waiting for them at home?
choices: Very anxious, fearing an accident
Happy and calm, reading by the fire
Cross with them for being so late
She had not noticed they were gone
questions.evidence: I have been so anxious, fancying all sorts of things
